# zones

`fastfiles::component` integrates fastfile loading, asset-link diagnostics, Scaleform overrides, and deferred patch-zone loading, while `fastfiles::enum_assets` exposes fastfile asset enumeration.

## Contents

- [fastfiles.cpp](./fastfiles.cpp) — Implements `fastfiles::component`, `enum_assets`, `CreateFileA` redirection, zone fallback lookup, asset-link normalization, diagnostics, and deferred `patch_mp`/`patch_consolation` loading.
- [fastfiles.hpp](./fastfiles.hpp) — Declares `fastfiles::enum_assets`.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`component::post_load()` installs `create_file_a_hook` and `db_link_xasset_entry_hook`, then schedules `load_patch_fastfiles_after_common()` through `scheduler::main`.

`create_file_a_stub()` handles read requests, redirects Scaleform paths through `find_scaleform_file()`, and retries zone fastfiles through `find_zone_file()` and `zone_lookup_roots()`.

`db_link_xasset_entry_stub()` normalizes rawfile names, tracks common and patch zones, and emits `debug_xasset()` diagnostics.

`get_pending_patch_zones()` discovers available override zones, and `load_patch_fastfiles_after_common()` submits them through `game::DB_LoadXAssets()` before refreshing UI data with `gametypes::refresh_ui_gametype_list()`.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `is_read_open_request()` accepts `GENERIC_READ` or `FILE_GENERIC_READ` with `OPEN_EXISTING` or `OPEN_ALWAYS`.
- `is_scaleform_file_path()` matches normalized `.gfx`/`.swf` paths containing `\scaleform\` or `\ui_mp\`.
- `is_zone_fastfile_path()` matches case-insensitive `.ff` paths containing `\zone\`.
- `is_scaleform_asset_name()` matches `.gfx`, `.swf`, `scaleform`, `mpsysmodeselect`, `mpxbplaylistselect`, `cmsharedplatform`, `gfxfontlib`, `pcsharedlibrary`, or `cmsharedlibrary`.
- `normalize_rawfile_name()` stores up to `1024` names in `normalized_rawfile_names[1024][256]` using `strncpy_s(..., _TRUNCATE)` and `normalized_rawfile_name_index++ % 1024`.
- `make_override_zone()` sets `allocFlags = 0x11` and `freeFlags = 0`.
- `get_asset_name()` returns `"<null>"`, `"<invalid>"`, or `"<unnamed>"` for absent, invalid, or empty asset data.
- `get_zone_name()` returns `"<none>"` for empty zone names.
- `create_file_a_stub()` logs `^5Opening Scaleform file %s\n`, `^5Loading Scaleform override %s\n`, and restores failed fallback errors with `SetLastError`.
- `get_pending_patch_zones()` logs `^1Skipping override fastfile '%s' because it was not found\n`.
- `load_patch_fastfiles_after_common()` uses `patch_sync = 0` and may log `^3Submitted patch fastfile(s), but no linked assets were observed yet: %s\n`.

## File Relationships

`fastfiles.hpp` supplies the public declaration consumed by `fastfiles.cpp`, while `fastfiles.cpp` connects `fastfiles::enum_assets` to `game::DB_EnumXAssets_FastFile` and registers `REGISTER_COMPONENT(fastfiles::component)`.
